name: Pingvin Share
short_description: Self-hosted file sharing with expirable links and password protection.
description: Pingvin Share is a self-hosted file sharing platform that lets you create shareable links with expiration times, download limits, and password protection. A privacy-focused alternative to WeTransfer and similar services, with email notification support.
usecases: Share large files with temporary expirable links without cloud dependency.
Send password-protected files to clients or colleagues securely.
Receive file uploads from external users via reverse shares.
